name: G.G. Automotive Gears Ltd.
summary: G.G. Automotive Gears Ltd. engages in the manufacture of traction gears and pinions. Its products include railway gears and shafts; forged components and machined blanks; industrial gears and gearboxes; and mining and earth-moving equipment spares. The company was founded on February 15, 1974 and is headquartered in Dewas, India.
